sources.usage: Project brief, enums, allowed design space, ranges, and schemas.
Public/cleared/provisional source usability registry; distinguishes formal-ready, background-only, provisional-only, and needs-review materials.
Agent-readable navigation layer for scopes, required tasks, source-use boundaries, and missing-data checklist; not a new authority source.
Three required detailed-design key area boundaries (provisional).
Official announcement tasks, scope levels, key areas, language, and deliverable context.
Agent-facing open-call principles, six required agent tasks, scenario/branding/operation requirements, and boundary clause.

The user-provided Chinese master proposal `京张AI创新带-方案合稿.md` is the sole narrative and strategy source for this rebuilt package. It defines the title, one-core/three-zone/two-wing structure, five problem diagnoses, five strategies, four application loops, scenarios, phasing and communication language. An archival copy is preserved as `report/narrative.md`, synchronized with the claim-caliber downgrades recorded in appendix-f. Public-release and competition-submission rights confirmed by the submitting entity (@hdec-cgy) on 2026-08-31; per-asset ledger in assets/media/appendix-g-rights-inventory.md.
Policy context for the proposal's compute-infrastructure direction; exact quantitative claims require line-by-line verification before formal citation.
Background policy reference for green and low-carbon data-centre design; not treated as proof of site-specific engineering feasibility.

Supports the proposal's evidence-graph narrative and provisional spatial diagnosis. Acquisition caliber: Amap public POI interface, scraped 2026-08, WGS84; raw point tables ARE attached for audit: visual/assets/sandbox/data/university-data.js (535 university/institution points, WGS84 GeoJSON, name+coordinate dedup) and visual/assets/sandbox/data/tech-poi-data.js (1,171 tech POI points, of which the 556-count follows the AI-relevance classification rule recorded in appendix-f F1a). Used as statistical caliber only for relative-density comparison, not item-by-item verified and not bulk-redistributed. Derived figures are labelled as design evidence with explicit grades in assets/media/appendix-f-claims-audit.md, not statutory facts.

Case references in the master proposal are used as attribution-only textual/directional references; no third-party images, drawings, layouts or logos are reproduced in the package. Rights boundary recorded in assets/media/appendix-g-rights-inventory.md G.5.

Offline frozen snapshot (osm-202608) of OpenStreetMap data localised into visual/assets/sandbox/data/; (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, attribution shown in the sandbox UI; derived measurements (road density, breakpoints) are team-calculated on this snapshot with calibers in appendix-f.
Leaflet 1.9.4 localised into visual/assets/vendor/leaflet.js/css; (c) 2010-2023 Vladimir Agafonkin, BSD-2-Clause; copyright and licence header preserved in the bundled source file.

92 rendering figures (webp/png, bilingual) plus the cover under assets/figures/ and assets/media/cover.png, generated by the team with AI image tools and human-curated; disclosed per competition rules; no real portraits, corporate logos or third-party copyrighted source imagery as input; generation records available on request.

Formal AI-governance baseline for complaint channels, human responsibility and conditional security-assessment language. It is not used as proof that any filing, assessment or legal-compliance process has already been completed.
Formal accessibility baseline. The proposal treats accessibility as a design and verification objective and does not infer that existing or proposed facilities have already achieved legal compliance.
Background support for retaining telephone, paper, onsite and other non-smartphone service channels. It is not used to claim implementation or compliance by a specific operator.
